verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says that during a cloud coding session, Linear Agent detects and installs the toolchains and dependencies it needs, and can set up, run and test code before returning work. Teams can also pin runtime versions and add setup scripts. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on detection scope (which languages and toolchains are supported) and independent or hands-on corroboration that auto-install works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task

citations.quote: During a session, Linear detects and installs the toolchains and dependencies it needs to complete the task.
Linear Agent can now set up, run, and test your code before returning its work.
Coding sessions run in the cloud, so you can prototype ideas and make changes without setting up a local development environment.
Teams can go further by pinning runtime versions, adding setup scripts, and defining environment variables.
